budget_items.topic: Cost of a community gathering place at 30 School Street
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A proposal to redevelop the former primary school site as a community gathering place was costed at $5 Million and rejected at Town Meeting.
budget_items.quote: there was a proposal to redevelop the site as a community gathering place and would cost $5 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The only accepted proposal was to sell the Brooks House for $1, with the buyer moving the house; there were no takers.
budget_items.quote: the only proposal that was accepted by the town was to sell the brooks house for $1, with the buyer moving the house but they had no takers.

budget_items.topic: Rehab cost for consolidated community building (TC Passios)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rehabilitating the TC Passios building for consolidated town offices was reported at $28-30 Million, of which $14 Million is for code updates.
budget_items.quote: now it would cost $28-30 million to rehab the building, of which $14 million is just for code updates.

budget_items.topic: Ritter Building annex for town offices
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The office building annex was estimated at $5 Million, with the goal of a debt exclusion vote the following year.
budget_items.quote: building the office building would be $5 million and the goal is to do a debt exclusion next year for this project.

budget_items.topic: Funding for municipal buildings and property development
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Funding is described as the main barrier and would come from taxpayers through debt exclusion; no figure was stated for this general point.
budget_items.quote: in regard to municipal buildings, the number #1 barrier is money, which would be debt exclusion.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Evan reported $1.9 Million in Chapter 90 funds with no known plan for their use.
budget_items.quote: evan noted there is $1.9 million in chapter 90 funds but no one seems to know what the plan is for these.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Karin reported the schools are looking for a 2 ½ override to address staffing and the elementary school.
budget_items.quote: they are looking for a 2 ½ override for the schools.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Water Department is looking for $32 Million to address PFAS.
budget_items.quote: the water department is looking for $32 million to address pfas.
